user.title: Create new list
user.description: Family Todo creates a real todo list that works with Home Assistant's own to-do card and voice assistant (Assist). Add more lists directly in the sidepanel.

corrupt_list.title: The to-do list "{name}" could not be fully loaded
corrupt_list.description:
{count} entries in the list "{name}" had a format that could not be read and are not shown. The rest of the list works as usual.

The original data, including the broken entries, is saved unchanged in `{backup}` in your Home Assistant configuration folder, in case you want to restore something by hand.

This issue clears itself the next time the list loads without errors (i.e. after a restart once the list has been saved again).
